strings.en: Sammy: Champion.{SCROLL}Sammy: I’m going back to my own time{NEWLINE}with Celebi now. Thank you so much{CLEAR}for all your help. I hope we meet{CLEAR}again in your time, 40 years from now!

strings.zh: 保重啊雪城。{NEWLINE}回去之后记得保守雪拉比的秘密,{CLEAR}也不要做影响未来的事哦！
strings.en: Take care, Sammy. When you get{NEWLINE}back, remember to keep Celebi’s{CLEAR}secret, and don’t do anything{CLEAR}that would change the future!

strings.zh: 雪城『放心吧姐姐,我知道该怎么做。
strings.en: Sammy: Don’t worry, Big{NEWLINE}Sis. I know what to do.

strings.zh: 雪城『再见姐姐,再见冠军大人！{NEWLINE}谢谢你们！
strings.en: Sammy: Goodbye, Big Sis!{NEWLINE}Goodbye, Champion! Thank you!

strings.zh: 一切平安,真的是太好了。
strings.en: Everyone’s safe. That’s such a relief.

strings.zh: 冠军大人,这次事件多亏有您{NEWLINE}雪拉比和雪城才能平安返回,{CLEAR}这是我作为一名退休护林员{CLEAR}对您的一片感谢之心,{CLEAR}请您收下吧。
strings.en: Champion, thanks to you, Celebi{NEWLINE}and Sammy made it home safely.{CLEAR}This is a token of gratitude from a{CLEAR}retired ranger. Please accept it.

strings.zh: 空
strings.notes: v3 TM: 138 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 不知道雪城长大之后,{NEWLINE}是现在时空里的哪个人呢……{CLEAR}哈哈,好想看看啊。
strings.en: I wonder who Sammy grew up to be in{NEWLINE}our time... Ha ha, I’d love to know.

strings.zh: 这次治疗雪拉比总共需要{NEWLINE}10个月见山泉水、{CLEAR}10个大树果{CLEAR}以及一只擅长发光的精灵。{SCROLL}请你尽快把我刚才说的{NEWLINE}道具和精灵都带过来,拜托了。
strings.en: To treat Celebi, we need 10 Fresh{NEWLINE}Water, 10 Sitrus Berries, and one{CLEAR}Pokémon that’s good at making light.{SCROLL}Please bring the items and the{NEWLINE}Pokémon I just mentioned as soon{CLEAR}as you can. I’m counting on you.

strings.zh: 桐树林的祠堂……{NEWLINE}供奉着森林之神。
strings.en: The shrine of Ilex Forest... It{NEWLINE}honors the god of the forest.

strings.zh: 洁咪『Shaaa——min！
strings.en: Shaymin: Shaaa-min!

strings.zh: 洁咪『Shaaa——min！{SCROLL}洁咪想要跟你一起玩,{NEWLINE}要让洁咪加入队伍吗？
strings.en: Shaymin: Shaaa-min!{SCROLL}Shaymin wants to play with you.{NEWLINE}Let Shaymin join your party?

strings.zh: 队伍满了！
strings.en: Your party is full!

strings.zh: 洁咪加入了队伍！
strings.en: Shaymin joined your party!

strings.en: Give Shaymin a nickname?{VAR:0200:0}{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 雪拉比『Ceee——le！
strings.en: Celebi: Ceee-le!

strings.zh: 雪拉比『Ceee——le！{SCROLL}雪拉比想要跟你一起玩,{NEWLINE}要让雪拉比加入队伍吗？
strings.en: Celebi: Ceee-le!{SCROLL}Celebi wants to play with you.{NEWLINE}Let Celebi join your party?

strings.zh: 雪拉比加入了队伍！
strings.en: Celebi joined your party!

strings.zh: 要给雪拉比起昵称吗？{VAR:0200:0}{SCROLL}
strings.en: Give Celebi a nickname?{VAR:0200:0}{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在时间的长河中,{NEWLINE}总有一些事情让人遗憾。{CLEAR}有什么发生过的事情,{CLEAR}是你无论如何都想要改变的吗？
strings.en: In the long river of time, there are{NEWLINE}always things to regret. Is there{CLEAR}anything that happened that you{CLEAR}want to change, no matter what?
strings.notes: Celebi's second time trip: menu #120 change history → S.S. Anne (#123-#136: stop Archie's engine bomb) / #121 leave it.

strings.zh: 我看不得无辜的人被杀害
strings.en: I can’t watch innocents be killed
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'I can’t stand innocents being killed'

strings.zh: 还是不要改变历史比较好
strings.en: Better not to change history

strings.zh: 雪拉比正在积蓄能量！
strings.en: Celebi is gathering energy!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『喂！炸弹安装好了没？{NEWLINE}什么时候能够引爆？
strings.en: Archie: Hey! Is the bomb set{NEWLINE}up yet? When can we set it off?

strings.zh: 报告水吾桐大人,{NEWLINE}炸弹的最终调试已经完成,{CLEAR}随时可以进行安装和引爆。
strings.en: Report, Master Archie! The bomb’s{NEWLINE}final tests are done. It can be{CLEAR}installed and detonated at any time.

strings.zh: 报告水吾桐大人,{NEWLINE}刚刚有个小鬼来捣乱{CLEAR}所以耽误了一会儿时间,{CLEAR}不过马上就能重新安装完毕。
strings.en: Report, Master Archie! Some{NEWLINE}brat came and caused trouble,{CLEAR}so we lost a little time, but we’ll{CLEAR}have it reinstalled in no time.

strings.zh: 水吾桐『好,尽快给我把炸弹{NEWLINE}装到游轮引擎上,{CLEAR}我不允许有任何一个活口{CLEAR}把火箭队的事给传出去。
strings.en: Archie: Good. Get that bomb onto{NEWLINE}the ship’s engine as fast as you{CLEAR}can. I won’t let a single soul live{CLEAR}to spread word about Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 是！水吾桐大人！
strings.en: Yes, Master Archie!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我这是跑到圣安努号上来了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Am I on the S.S. Anne?

strings.zh: 水吾桐『你是刚刚在船长室的那个小鬼？{NEWLINE}真是个不怕死的家伙,{CLEAR}居然敢追到这里来。
strings.en: Archie: You’re that brat from{NEWLINE}the captain’s cabin just now?{CLEAR}You really don’t fear death,{CLEAR}chasing me all the way here.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『就是你们炸毁了引擎,{NEWLINE}才导致了圣安努号上无数的生命惨死。{CLEAR}我不会再让这样的悲剧发生了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’re the ones who blew{NEWLINE}up the engine and killed countless{CLEAR}people on the S.S. Anne. I won’t{CLEAR}let that tragedy happen again!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『真是狂妄至极,{NEWLINE}就凭你这样的初级训练家,{CLEAR}是不可能战胜我的！
strings.en: Archie: What arrogance! A Junior{NEWLINE}Trainer like you could never beat me!
strings.notes: ext-review RV-020: 初级训练家 = Junior Trainer (D-0323)

strings.zh: 水吾桐『居然拥有这么强大的力量！？{NEWLINE}怎么可能,刚刚在船长室的时候,{CLEAR}你只不过是个……
strings.en: Archie: You have this much power?! How{NEWLINE}is that possible? Back in the captain’s{CLEAR}cabin, you were nothing but a...

strings.zh: 水吾桐『不……你和刚刚船长室里的{NEWLINE}那个小鬼不是一个人。{CLEAR}我从你的眼神中能看出来,{CLEAR}你是那种经历过{CLEAR}无数次生死之战的强者。{CLEAR}可恶,真是不甘心啊……
strings.en: Archie: No... You’re not the same{NEWLINE}brat who was in the captain’s{CLEAR}cabin. I can see it in your eyes.{CLEAR}You’re someone who’s been through{CLEAR}countless life-or-death battles.{CLEAR}Damn, this is so frustrating...

strings.zh: 水吾桐『喂！出现了非常麻烦的敌人,{NEWLINE}这不是现在的我所能应付的。{CLEAR}立刻撤退！
strings.en: Archie: Hey! A really nasty enemy{NEWLINE}has shown up, one I can’t handle{CLEAR}right now. Retreat at once!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这样一来,{NEWLINE}圣安努号上的乘客就都得救了吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: With this, the passengers{NEWLINE}of the S.S. Anne are all saved, right?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我这是又回到桐树林了？{NEWLINE}我真的穿越时空拯救了圣安努号吗……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Am I back in Ilex Forest?{NEWLINE}Did I really travel through{CLEAR}time and save the S.S. Anne...?
